## Material findings

None. I found no material regression or failure in this delta.

The mechanism holds up against the live player source:

- **Activation without navigation.** `ksvl-player.js:1632-1639` delegates capture-phase clicks on `button[data-ksvl-start-live]` to `startLive()`. Both new controls are `<button type="button" data-ksvl-start-live>` (`index.html:1171`, radio pill), so the selector matches. The `href="/radio.html" target="_blank"` and the `↗` affordance are gone from both; the pill's arrow is now an `aria-hidden` `▶`. Copy on both banner widths now describes bottom controls rather than another tab.
- **No duplicate deck.** Two independent guards: `mountKSVL` skips injection when `__KSVL_CANONICAL_PLAYER__` is set or when any script's resolved *pathname* is `/content/site/ksvl-player.js` (query-string agnostic, resolves relative srcs), and the player IIFE itself returns early on `__KSVL_CANONICAL_PLAYER__` (`ksvl-player.js:19-20`). On `index.html` the header runs first (defer, document order) and the scan still sees the body's deferred player tag, so nothing is injected.
- **No new-visitor autoplay.** `mount()` calls `hydrateFromStorage(consumeContinuation())`, and `consumeContinuation` requires a `NAV_KEY` written on a same-origin link click within 15s with a matching normalized path. With no saved state, `hydrateFromStorage` returns before touching audio, and `ensureNowPlaying` is never called — so the four newly covered pages render no bar at all for non-listeners. The catalogue-failure `announce` is gated on `mountEl || IS_POPUP`, so a registry failure can't pop a bar on `learn.html` either.
- **Real controls / state.** Pause-resume, prev/next, seek, volume, mute and Stop are the existing deck; `saveState`/`restoreQueue` persist track, position, shuffle, repeat, volume and mute under a 6-hour TTL, gated on registry identity.
- **Element-type change is styled correctly.** `.homepage-radio-pill` (`index.html:1068`) already declares `display:flex`, `width:100%`, `box-sizing`, border, background, colour and `font:500 1.05rem/1.45 Jost` — everything a `<button>` would otherwise lose to UA defaults; the added rule supplies the only two missing pieces (`text-align:left`, `cursor:pointer`). `button.dyk-slide` gets `font:inherit;width:100%;text-align:left`, and the slim-carousel rules out-specify it for border/background. Child `div`s were correctly converted to `span`s for valid button content. Both banner screenshots match the parent's palette, artwork, type and control cluster.
- **Carousel unaffected.** `homepage.js:609` is the only place the slide's heading was read; `h3, .dyk-title` covers the new markup, and the announcement text is unchanged. Nothing else in the carousel assumes an anchor. Hidden slides keep `visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none`, so the new button is neither clickable nor tabbable while off-stage.
- **Unrelated homepage retained.** The diff touches only the radio slide, the pill, the `h3`→`:is(h3,.dyk-title)` selector widening (no computed-style change for existing `h3` slides), two cache-bust bumps, and one appended script tag per page. Other slides, masthead, needs shortcuts and directory are untouched.

Two non-material notes, offered only because they are inside the delta: `index.html` still requests the player as `?v=20260829-touch-targets-1` while the header and the four new includes use `?v=20260830-continuity-1` — same file, one deck per page, but two cache entries; and the Library screenshot shows the deck **paused** with a `RESUME` button, which is consistent with the recorded fields (`libraryControls` only — no `libraryAutoResumed` is claimed) and with the scope's explicit disclaimer that full-document navigation reloads audio.

## Evidence

Six candidate screenshots (parent/candidate banner at 1440 and 390, `learn-controls-390`, `library-controls-1440`); `scope.md`, `source-diff.patch`, `manifest.json`, `browser-checks.json`, `producer-self-review.md`; the working-tree bytes of `index.html`, `content/site/homepage.js`, `content/site/sv-global-header.js`, `learn.html`; and the unchanged player runtime at the temp path. `browser-checks.json` is `status: PASS`, `hosted: false`, with two width rows (1440/390: started `town-anthem`, no new tab, fixed controls, single player, pause/resume/next/previous, learn position retained and auto-resumed, library controls, stopped, no errors) and six route rows (`/newsstand`, `/fun-connect`, `/games/dream-phone`, `/games/fairy-godmother`, `/resident-referrals`, `/grimoire/verification-rulebook`) each recording saved track, paused restore and a single fixed player, plus `freshVisitorSilent: true`.

I confirmed the working tree matches the patch at each site I read: `sv-global-header.js:314-345`, `index.html:1098`, `index.html:1101`, `index.html:1171-1174`, `learn.html:103`.

## Limits

- **Hashes are declared, not verified.** Read-only with no shell means I could not compute SHA-256 over any file; the table reproduces `manifest.json`, which `browser-checks.json` independently repeats. Spot-reading confirmed the *content* matches the patch at the sites above, but not the digests.
- **Browser evidence is the producer's, not reproduced.** I did not run Chrome, click either control, hear audio, or observe state across a navigation. Every runtime claim above is a source-level reading of the delegation, guard and hydration paths plus the producer's recorded rows.
- **Unread source.** I read roughly the first 924 and last 280 lines of the 1660-line player; the middle (queue advance, `playCurrentPart`, `startMix`, `popOutPlayer` body) is unread. It is unchanged by this delta, so this bounds only my ability to spot a pre-existing defect, not a regression.
- **Coverage completeness unverified.** I did not enumerate which pages carry the shared header, so I cannot independently confirm the scope's claims that these four pages were the only gaps or that embedded book fragments and redirects stay player-free. No route row covers a fragment or an iframed page. If a fragment does load the shared header, it would now mount its own fixed deck inside the frame — worth one spot check before promotion.
- **Pill has no dedicated evidence.** Neither a screenshot nor a distinct `browser-checks` field covers the listening pill; `started: "town-anthem"` and the self-review describe the *banner* click. My conclusion that the pill activates the player and keeps its styling is a source reading (selector match at `ksvl-player.js:1636`, CSS at `index.html:1068`), not observation.
- Preview only. Nothing was written, and I took no shell or application action.
